messages.text:
Could you let me name a game before I save it, so its name comes back when I load my saved progress? Please follow the project rules.

Some saved games won't open after I paste them, even though my own exports work. Could you fix that and keep the rest working?

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Plan the work first. Then hand each task to its own subagent with the context it needs, and don't edit the code yourself.

Added **Deal name** under **Reproduce a game**; names now save and restore with progress. Fixed pasted snapshots failing because their JSON fields appeared in a different order. Existing unnamed saves remain supported.

All work was delegated as requested. Typechecking, 150 unit tests, and 86 browser journeys passed.

Changed files pass formatting. The repository-wide check still flags 13 unchanged files with pre-existing formatting issues.
